properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 30 at 1:41PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 140 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Hoehne, or 8 miles north of Trinidad, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Trinidad, Model, and Hoehne.
